verdict.rationale: dlt is a data-loading library/platform, not an agent that consumes external tools via MCP; the evidence only shows dlt shipping its own MCP servers for agents to call into it (dlt-docs-72, dlt-probe-4), not dlt itself acting as an MCP client plugging in third-party servers. This axis (product consuming external MCP tool servers) is a category error for a data pipeline framework.
